Initial release: RIA ADV / Form CRS compliance checklist skill.

- Provides an activation checklist for ADV updates, Form CRS delivery, Marketing Rule, Custody, and Books & Records compliance.
- Includes specific triggers and red flags for when to use the checklist.
- Offers examples, compliance anchors, and verification steps tied to SEC/state rules.
- Supplies tailored packs for solo RIAs and CCOs.
- Not intended for portfolio construction questions; focus is strictly compliance.
